## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem, the change, and the effect for users. Link a related issue when one exists.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results. Identify checks that were skipped and any remaining limitations.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe changes to suite or report formats, backend requirements, examples, or installation. State whether documentation or generated Action files changed.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] The change contains no real tokens, private targets, internal domains, or account data.
- [ ] Applicable tests and documentation are updated.
- [ ] Generated Action files are rebuilt when required.
- [ ] New source files have license headers, and existing third-party notices are preserved.
- [ ] External code or dependency changes identify their source and license.
